content:
CONFIRMED — `GET /api/v1/host` exposes `hostId` but no canonical `workspaceId`, while artifact scope validation compares `workspaceId` directly against the session’s path-valued `workingDirectory`. Clients therefore cannot discover the stable workspace identity, and artifact authorization collapses identity into filesystem paths.

Exact scoped line: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\applications\ji-host-web\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\web\LocalHostServer.java:952`
